name: Losing Your Salvation
overview: The question of losing one's salvation is addressed in Scripture with both warnings and assurances. Ezekiel 18:24 and Matthew 7:21 emphasize that turning away from righteousness and failing to do God's will jeopardizes life and entrance into His kingdom. Conversely, John 10:28 and Romans 11:29 affirm the security of the believer, highlighting that those given eternal life are kept securely in Christ's hand and that God's gifts and calling are irrevocable. Hebrews 6:4, however, warns of the seriousness of falling away after experiencing the Holy Spirit, underscoring the gravity of apostasy. Together, these passages present a tension between the believer's secure position in Christ and the responsibility to persevere in faith and obedience.
